a1.label: 1. From January, invoices...
a1.why: The text says invoices will be processed automatically by a document-recognition system from January.

a2.label: 2. Accounting employees will...
a2.why: The text says employees will spend less time on data entry and more time checking unusual cases.

a3.label: 3. Complex HR requests will be handled by...
a3.why: The text says complex requests will still be handled by real people.

a4.label: 4. IoT sensor data will be used to...
a4.why: The text says the data will be used to predict failures before they happen.

a5.label: 5. Downtime is expected to fall by...
a5.why: The text says the CTO expects downtime to fall by 30 per cent.

a6.label: 6. The working group will review...
a6.why: The text says a working group will review data quality every quarter.

b1.label: 1. Replacing manual tasks with machines/software
b1.why: ‘Automation’ means replacing manual tasks with machines or software.

b2.label: 2. Connects devices and sensors to the internet
b2.why: ‘IoT’ (Internet of Things) connects everyday devices and sensors to the internet.

b3.label: 3. Systems learn patterns from data
b3.why: ‘Machine learning’ is when systems learn patterns from data instead of following fixed rules.

b4.label: 4. Answers customer questions in a chat window
b4.why: A ‘chatbot’ answers simple customer questions in a chat window.

b6.label: 6. Repairing machines before they break down
b6.why: ‘Predictive maintenance’ means repairing machines before they break down.

b7.label: 7. Overlays digital information onto the real world
b7.why: ‘Augmented reality’ overlays digital information onto the real world.

c1.label: 1. Invoices ___ processed automatically
c1.why: The passive future ‘will be’ + past participle describes a planned future process.

c2.label: 2. The chatbot ___ to answer HR questions
c2.why: ‘Is going to’ describes a planned future arrangement, matching the reading text.

c3.label: 3. Experts believe downtime ___ fall
c3.why: ‘Is likely to’ agrees with the singular subject ‘downtime’ and expresses a probable prediction.

c4.label: 4. The server ___ crash soon!
c4.why: ‘Is going to’ is used for a prediction based on present evidence (the error rates).

c5.label: 5. I think AI ___ change our jobs
c5.why: ‘Will’ is used for a personal opinion or prediction.

c6.label: 6. The sensors ___ installed by December
c6.why: ‘Will have been’ + past participle is the future perfect passive, matching ‘by December’.
